newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr was weaker against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.

The Bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 6.40 to the dollar compared with 6.38 last week. It said all deals between December 16 and 22 and resulting from the December 14 auction would be at 6.40 to the dollar.

The bank quoted the birr against the pound at a mean rate of 10.6141 from 10.5267 last week. On the yen, the birr was traded at 0.056666 from 0.056389, and at 4.1481 to the mark from 4.1333 last week.
